verdict.rationale: Pika documents its own 'Camera Director' app, which reshoots a clip from any angle and reimagines the shot from a different viewpoint. That is first-party camera direction, but the evidence frames it as viewpoint re-angling of an existing clip. It does not document explicit pan, zoom, orbit or static move controls at generation time. Pikaframes lets a prompt guide motion between keyframes, but that is not named camera-move control. Missing for 10: documented pan/zoom/orbit/static move selection, camera-move control during text/image-to-video generation, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
